purpose: Assess only whether the scoped productive L03 activity-utterance pattern is eligible for later curriculum mapping, without assigning any slot or authoring curriculum.

eligibility_proposals.subject: FIRST_ELIGIBLE_LANE
eligibility_proposals.boundary: OPI and QA remain on hold.

eligibility_proposals.subject: SURFACE_SCOPE
eligibility_proposals.boundary: No new form, function token or structural expansion.

eligibility_proposals.subject: GRAMMATICAL_LIMITS
eligibility_proposals.boundary: No person, tense, aspect, modality, habituality, frequency, negation, interrogation or zero-pronoun inference.

eligibility_proposals.subject: SLOT_ASSIGNMENT
eligibility_proposals.boundary: A later exact source-to-slot mapping gate is required.

eligibility_proposals.subject: NEXT_STEP
eligibility_proposals.boundary: Do not map or author under eligibility approval.
